Welcome to the first stop in your appraisal career—Hethereau, a sprawling and vibrant metropolis!

In the crowded halls of the Bureau of Anomaly Control, hopeful Oddities queue up for resident permits, while over at the train station, an Esper commuter snaps his fingers to clean his work suit on the fly. Down one block, a chaotic chase after Danzaburou is spiraling out of control; while across the street, a vacationing silver-gloved Butler is shooting the breeze  with the owner of a second-hand electronics shop. Everywhere you look, there's no shortage of intriguingly "abnormal" scenes.

Want to dive deeper into a world where humans and the supernatural coexist? Start your journey in Hethereau to see it for yourself. The lively and quirky daily life here is a grand adventure in itself.

◆ Interesting Stories, Lighthearted Connections

Today's Top Story: Rumors are swirling about a mysterious pawnshop that only appears on the night of the full moon. What would you trade for a wish?

Breaking News: Taygedo's romance crisis! Romance and impulse, heartbreak and missed chances—Miss Tako, the object of a secret crush, is about to leave Hethereau with her guarantor. How will the lovestruck otter get his feelings across before it's too late?

name: ScreenZen- Screen Time Control
description:

5. Messages like "Is this important" before opening your app.

name: Erudite Trivia: Spin the Brain
description:
Do you remember when you were small, your grandmother or grandfather always were doing brain teasers: crosswords, quizzes, trivia, and sudoku? All these educational games for adults and almost all of us thought it was boring and they were only doing it because there is nothing else to do. That is not the case. They were doing brain training. Our brain is like our body is needed to be trained and looked after. You won’t have the same ease of remembering something in your 70s, unfortunately. To keep your brain sharp, you need to practice, and the best practice is when you don’t get bored. You are playing a game, and the brain thinks that you are relaxing, but you are actually training. Check your general knowledge while playing our game. We have questions on every topic: history, science, even vexillology.

So how does our game work? As you expected from a logic puzzle game. You have questions, and you need to answer them. We designed a new style for quizzes. The main question is located right in the center, and there are two circles. One is for hint questions and another for answers. All you need to do is to match them. So it is a quiz game for adults with a puzzle element that looks like trivia. For each correct answer, you will get points. Ingeniously, isn’t it? Each card with a question gives you three tries. After that, you will lose all bonuses you’ve got while doing this card. Our game’s puzzles consist of interesting facts, some of them you know, some of them you will need to recollect. Don't worry we'll test your knowledge with a few mind games here and there.

We have loads and loads of puzzles and questions

INTVL turns every walk, run or bike ride into a game played on the real world globe. The idea is simple. When you run or ride in a loop, the ground inside that loop becomes your territory. The bigger, smarter and more tactical your routes, the more of the map you hold.

Claim your territory

Every loop you complete claims real space. Other players are out there doing the same thing, so the map is always moving. You can take a new route to take new ground, or go back over an area to defend what's already yours.

Play it your way

Hold ground, win real prizes

Every bit of the map you hold earns you entries into our competitions, where the prizes are real. The more territory you hold at the end of the competition, the better your odds.

A feed built around the game

INTVL has a social feed where you can follow other players, see their activities, and cheer them on. It's a good way to find people around you and stay connected to other athletes around the world.

Bring your own gear

- Garmin
- Suunto
- Polar
- Coros
- Fitbit
- Hammerhead
- Wahoo

We built INTVL to give a new meaning to fitness. Movement without stakes is just exercise. The world is the game. Take it.

name: 1Blocker: Ad Blocker
description:
1Blocker lets you block obtrusive ads, sneaky trackers, and annoying elements on sites. With 1Blocker, you’re safe online and nothing will distract you from enjoying sites.

1Blocker is very easy to use — just flip a couple of switches to start blocking ads and trackers. The app will automatically receive cloud updates to the built-in filters silently, so you don’t need to do anything. It’s as simple as setting and forgetting.

1Blocker is a fully native app designed to extend Safari naturally. It’s lightweight and doesn’t drain your battery by taking up your device’s resources.

The blocking itself is super fast because Safari does it itself. We only provide filters to Safari and don’t modify webpages in any way. This vastly improves efficiency because Safari knows in advance what should be blocked. So, with 1Blocker, sites load on average 2-5x faster.

It’s important to note that not all ads can be blocked though. Some sites use techniques that make it impossible for us to block their ads using currently available features for Safari content blockers.

SECURE BY DESIGN

1Blocker is secure and private. It doesn’t have access to webpages and doesn’t track you in any way.

We believe that privacy is not for sale. That's why we don't have an "Acceptable Ads" program. We stay independent, and the only way we make money is through direct sales of 1Blocker in the App Store to you.

ADVANCED CUSTOMIZATION

1Blocker is a highly customizable content blocker, providing the possibility to create powerful custom rules. It allows you to create custom rules that block any URL by providing a regular expression or hide any element by CSS. It also lets you block cookies. (Available in Premium)

AVAILABLE ON ALL DEVICES

1Blocker is available for iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Your preferences and custom rules are always in sync through iCloud no matter which device you're using.

**REAL BLOCKING, NOT A SUGGESTION**

The idea is based off the Premack Principle - things you do often can help reinforce things that you do rarely. By habit stacking a difficult habit before an app you often use,

WHEN IT APPLIES
All day until your habits are done, on a schedule, only in certain places, or near a device you pick. Habits First helps you wake up into a calm phone screen, only unlocked
after you finish your most important habits of the day.

PRICING
This app will never have a subscription fee. The core app is free forever: Apple Health goals, app timers, schedules, places, commitment locks, widgets, and as many blocks

description:
How smart are you really? Take a full IQ test, get your IQ score on the bell curve and see where you stand compared to others. Developed with students of the University of Rostock (Germany) and inspired by the WAIS-IV.

WHAT YOU GET
- A complete IQ exam with realistic tasks from many categories
- Your IQ score on a bell curve (normal distribution) – instantly see how you compare
- Detailed statistics for every category: discover your strengths and weaknesses
- Review your right and wrong answers after each category
- Puzzles and exercises in three difficulty levels, with hints, solutions and explanations
- Available in English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Turkish and Dutch
- Pro without ads – as a one-time purchase, so you don't need a subscription

WHAT THE IQ TEST MEASURES
Inspired by the WAIS-IV (Wechsler Adult Intelligence Scale), the test covers six areas:
- Perceptual reasoning
- Processing speed
- Working memory
- Verbal comprehension
- Numerical reasoning
- Logical thinking

You solve tasks such as matrix reasoning, number sequences, cube folding, image memory, patterns, analogies, estimation, ordering numbers and letters, logic questions and more.

WHAT IS AN IQ TEST?
An IQ test shows how you perform compared to other people. Intelligence itself is not clearly defined – it is simply what an IQ test measures. That's why only results of the same test can be compared: an IQ above 100 means you solved the tasks better than average, below 100 means worse. So don't take your score too seriously – see it as an exciting comparison with others!

BRAIN TRAINING AND TEST PREPARATION
Preparing for an aptitude test, an assessment center or a psychological test? Use the puzzles and exercises to train your brain and sharpen your logical thinking, memory and math skills.
